evidence.art: Painted title (000-003) and film (005-018) cohesive, moody, warm/blue palette; sets 025-048 rich, 047 stunning. Film banding/ghosting in the mask dissolve (011); sceptre head cropped out of 014/015/017.
evidence.continuity: Film Anpu (014-018 blue/gold painted, ankh scaled large 014) and Ankhu (barefoot 014-017) do not match real-time models (019-048 plasticky, teal nemes, olive sash, sandals); attendants a different art style from the painted set; painted-to-3D jump 018->019 jarring. Prop canon mostly honoured; sceptre vertical 040/042 but drags at an angle 031/041.
evidence.cinematography: Painted backdrops give strong fixed-camera compositions (030, 040, 047); letterbox + fade to gate 046-048 good. Weakened by huge foreground attendants blocking leads and subtitles (020, 032-034, 040-041), tiny actors in wide cuts (025-029, 037, 039), Anpu cropped to torso 024.
evidence.motion_fx: Stiff wide-legged gait with little pose variety (019, 031, 039, 041); Anpu hand-on-hip 019; visible overlap/merging 038, 043-045. Brazier flames alive; dust/foot FX barely visible at this scale.
evidence.grounding: Contact shadows exist (040, 041) but attendant stands on top of a brazier pedestal 042; Anpu and Ankhu clip into each other (038, 043-045); Anpu hidden behind attendants 043-045; scale vs huge statues plausible; 3D lighting does not match painted plate.
evidence.game_feel: Group ends clumped at the gate (043-045) with no clear player direction; abrupt cut handover (cut1 021, cut5 040); subtitles sometimes blocked; slow pace with little affordance. Ending fade to Ankhu alone (046-048) a strong beat.
evidence.ui_title: Gold serif logo and diamond/underline menu highlight (000-003) strong; menu type small and pale over busy columns, logo crowds the lintel. Subtitles legible serif, good placement (039, 041) but late fade-in 036 and crowded by foreground heads.
evidence.audio: From script files only, not heard: alternating Ankhu/Anpu exchange across cams 2-5 closing with Anpu at cam6 (019-042) emotionally coherent; short well-directed lines (warm, grave, hushed); 'held it in the water' callback to the film is a smart tie. No timing data reviewed, so sync and pacing unverified.

defects.what: Real-time Anpu, Ankhu and attendants do not match the painted film designs in style or details: 3D Anpu teal nemes and olive sash vs film's blue and gold; plasticky skin and stiff rigs clash with painted backdrops, breaking the film-to-play handover.
Actors overlap and merge: Anpu swallowed by attendants in the closing cut, attendant stands on a brazier pedestal 042, sceptre tilts or drags; gait and collision unresolved.
Oversized foreground attendants block Anpu, Ankhu and subtitles while wide cuts shrink the leads to specks against the statues; focus and hierarchy lost, framing needs a leads-first safe zone.
